verdict.rationale: Sign-in method is a fair question for a government tax portal with professional and personal accounts, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows sign-in entry-point labels ('Connexion à l’espace professionnel', 'Connexion à mon espace Finances publiques'). It never describes the authentication method, so there is nothing showing a remote credential-MFA path, or ruling out biometric liveness, in-person visits or a PIN sent by physical mail.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
